question:
A transformer is rated at $5\,\text{kVA}$ with a secondary rating of $250\,\text{V}$ (rms). A student claims: “It can deliver $5\,\text{kW}$ to any load because the rating is $5\,\text{kVA}$.”

The load to be supplied has power factor $0.8$ lagging. Evaluate the claim by determining the rated secondary current and the maximum real power that can be delivered without exceeding the kVA rating.
